auditItems.detail: Admin routes bind to localhost/private network only
Public API connects with restricted read-only role (DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL)
Fencing lease token required; direct PUBLISH without APPROVE blocked
ssh-key-*.key and .env files gitignored and blocked by pre-commit hooks
Public API enforces express rate limiting and explicit origin allowlists
Cron scheduler disabled by default; requires explicit approval

verdict: SYSTEM MEETS ALL PRODUCTION SAFETY AND LEAST-PRIVILEGE SECURITY STANDARDS
